name: spokeline
description: Talk to Claude Code hands-free and hear short spoken answers back. Works in the terminal, the VS Code panel and the desktop app.

listen.title: Listening mode
listen.description: off: never use the microphone. push_to_talk: hold the hotkey while you speak. hands_free: say the wake phrase, then your request.

hotkey.title: Push-to-talk key
hotkey.description: Hold this key while you speak. Examples: ctrl+option+space, cmd+shift+s, ctrl+option+v.

wake_phrase.title: Wake phrases
wake_phrase.description: In hands-free mode, start with one of these (after a short pause), then your request. Separate several phrases with commas.
wake_phrase.default: claude, hey claude, ok claude, anthropic, hey spokeline

barge_in.title: Interrupt by voice
barge_in.description: In hands-free mode, saying a wake phrase while Spokeline is talking stops it and starts listening. Uses the Mac's echo cancellation, like FaceTime.

pause_seconds.title: Seconds of silence before sending
pause_seconds.description: How long Spokeline waits after you stop talking before it sends what you said. Raise it if you get cut off; lower it for faster replies.

language.title: Speech language
language.description: The language you speak, as a code such as en-US, en-GB, de-DE or uk-UA. Empty means your Mac's language.

speak_answers.title: Speak answers
speak_answers.description: Read a short version of Claude's answer aloud.

speak_when.title: When to speak
speak_when.description: voice: only answers to requests you spoke. always: every answer in this chat.

summary.title: How answers are shortened
summary.description: smart: a small, fast Claude model rewrites the answer into 1-3 spoken sentences (uses a little of your plan). simple: no model call, just drop code, paths, tables and links.

natural_voice.title: Natural voice
natural_voice.description: The human-sounding voice that runs on this Mac (downloaded once, about 350 MB). American: heart, bella, nicole, sarah, michael, adam, puck. British: emma, isabella, george, fable. off: use the built-in macOS voice.

voice.title: Built-in macOS voice
voice.description: The exact name of a system voice, such as Samantha or Daniel. Empty means your Mac's default voice.

confirm_before_send.title: Check before sending
confirm_before_send.description: Put what you said into the input box first and wait for you to say 'send' or 'cancel'.

voice_approvals.title: Approve by voice
voice_approvals.description: When Claude asks for permission, read the request aloud and accept 'yes' or 'no' by voice. With no answer, the normal permission box appears.

approval_wait_seconds.title: Seconds to wait for a spoken yes or no
approval_wait_seconds.description: After this, the normal permission box appears.
